race.comment: REOFFENDER (1) comes here following a 12th behind Maestro at Group Two level two-and-a-half weeks ago over 2645m at this track. He has recorded 10 of his 11 career runs at this course and looks ideally placed to return to winning form. REGAL ATTIRE NZ (7) is racing well with 16 top-five finishes in succession, the latest effort a third at this track over 2230m after he raced outside the leader as the $1.65 favourite for the entire trip. Meets a comparable field so he is capable of continuing his fine form. MY BAD HABITS (4) is worth plenty of thought off a last-start all of the way win by 2.75 metres at this track over 2230m. ALDEBARAN DEXTA (6) is heading the right way, improving last time out to finish second to the above selection at this track over 2230m. Has solid each-way claims.
